newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates up as market awaits repo cut.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates up as market awaits repo cut.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates finished higher reflecting continued expectations that the central bank will cut its reverse repo rate, traders said.
Rates ended at 23.25 percent after moving in a range between 22.875 and 23.375 percent, having closed at around 23 percent on Wednesday.

"Everybody is doing business with the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) ahead of an expected (reverse) repo rate cut and they now have to take money from the overnight spot market," said Andrea Deak of Mezobank.
Traders said they expect the NBH's reverse repo rate cut to happen early next week.
